scope: Actual D435i RGB UVC interface detach/rebind, same capture owner, body/face/hand application, native VLM and legacy ROS restoration; bounded control-plane socket regressions. No physical cable unplug, microphone/speaker, B0 or endurance claim.
verified: Old health check accepted HTTP 200 with a wrong model name; fixed check validates configured alias and rejects mismatches
Old slot read exceeded 40ms per-read timeout and returned idle after 285ms of trickled JSON; new control-plane total budget ends the observation at about 41ms with TimeoutException
Startup, health, template capability and slot/counter GETs now use independent connections with total deadline and 64KiB retained JSON bound
Oversized declared/unannounced bodies, stalled headers and trickled control JSON are rejected; unconfirmed status never releases the turn; healthy observation subsequently restores admission
Real LLM identity/tools/idle and real ASR/TTS capabilities plus file/PCM inference succeed with the new control GET path
Old real D435i capture thread exited after RGB interface detach and stayed dead after rebind; new single capture owner releases/reopens and resumes with a new source epoch
Source invalidation immediately removes old camera/perception/face state and pending frame messages; closing during a read never releases that handle concurrently or publishes the late frame
Actual app rejects a camera question with 400 while offline, still completes a text-only turn, and completes native VLM question using the recovered epoch
WebSocket receives recovered epoch without later delivery of the old epoch; no images/landmarks or visual answer text saved in reports
One warmup plus 20 real camera start/read/close cycles: distinct epochs, invalidated old snapshots, empty camera buffers, constant post-close FD/thread counts
Owned application stops, then legacy service restores three distinct fresh RGB and aligned-depth frames; seven original services and native idle counters verified

camera_lifecycle.scope: Camera-only repeats, not complete app/audio/model lifecycle acceptance

known_limits: Driver detach/rebind passed twice after implementation; physical cable/hub interruption, silent stalled driver and final ten-times fault matrix remain unqualified
OpenCV 4.11 select timeout is configured before first capture; it does not preempt arbitrary kernel ioctl calls. A reader not released within close join remains an explicit close_unconfirmed error
The process-wide OpenCV timeout is cached by upstream; changing it requires an application process restart
144 tests and camera-only 20 cycles do not qualify complete F01-F12, physical sound, negative/multi-person gesture quality, 8h coexistence or B0
The real camera app probe disables audio and local tools, and disables automatic wave greetings to keep its diagnostic requests isolated
Health identity check validates declared model alias; artifact identity remains the responsibility of pinned backend deployment/manifest
TensorRT device-compatibility warning remains visible and tracked as RG-13; no BSP/CUDA/TRT upgrade or performance tuning performed
This test observed D435i USB speed 5000Mb/s; this is a current sysfs observation, not a throughput benchmark or a universal device property
verification_note: Final camera run includes the camera lifecycle loop and source-window invalidation guard. Full tests and native health calls cover final behavior; only an unused diagnostic-script import was removed afterward.
